title: feat(objectql)!: email template names held per namespace, a send resolves its template from its package, and ?package= reads an email template exactly (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 1/3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBHWCuY8Wd44TH1DXMgFmsUZ)_

Part of #31699
Supersedes #32089

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自带同名邮件模板；发送按发起它的包解析模板名（ADR-0150 D3），流程的 notify 节点传入流程自己被启用的包；不带包的发送保持原义（环境项 → 唯一持有者 → 409 列出全部持有者）；`?package=` 精确读取邮件模板；配对包里一条可能属于两个包的 Studio 新增语言行在两个精确地址都返回 409，`os migrate stored-references` 列出它；元数据内存存储对邮件模板按（包，名）分槽，两个包的同名模板不再互相覆盖；一条不带包的行（环境项或无包的 sys_metadata 行），若其名字被两个包持有，现在对所有按包读取的类型都在两个精确地址返回 409，并从两个包的列表中隐藏，`os migrate stored-references` 在 packageLessRows 下列出它。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的邮件模板部分；#32089 的合同复审 FAIL（F1：开关打开后两持有者的名字每次发送都被拒；F2：一条配对行同时被两个包当作自己的），史诗席位裁定两项都按根因修复；第二轮回应合同复审 6772203835（F-A 字面 payload.template 也按流程的包解析，F-B 声明的基包优先于 App 配对，F-C 如实说明今天没有门能把新增成员绑定到一个基包）以及史诗席位的无包行红线项。
- 风险与回滚：收窄四处（都已声明，第一方调用方 0，完整 dogfood 电池全绿）：`?package=X` 读 X 不持有的名字、阶段 1 前已封存的同名冲突的裸读、打包流程的 notify 模板在其依赖闭包之外、两持有者名字的无包行；其余只放宽。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts`（`bundleAddressOf`）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（`pairMemberOwners`、`packageLessRowOwners`）、`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-loader.test.ts src/send-template.test.ts`，以及 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，应全绿，其中 "[#31699 F1]"、"[#31699 F2]" 与 "[#31699] a package-less row…" 三节逐级钉住。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — four refusals where an item was served before. (1) `GET /meta/email_template/NAME?package=X` (and `getMetaItem` with a `packageId`) for a name package X does not hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`, naming every holder), where it served the first registered package's template; first-party callers that name a package: 0. (2) The bare `GET /meta/email_template/NAME` of a name two packages already held before the one-holder rule (a clash the cold boot seals with a warning) is refused `409` naming both, where it served the first registered one (ADR-0150, covered types). (3) A flow's `notify` node now sends its template as the flow's own package (`SendTemplateInput.callerPackageId`): from a package whose own flow body is armed, a template name no holder in that package's declared dependency closure holds (another package's template outside it, or a template only the environment authored) is refused `409` naming the holders, where the send served the one holder; first-party packaged flows that send a template: 0. (4) A read naming a package (`?package=X`, `getMetaItem` with a `packageId`, `/meta/TYPE/NS/NAME`) that reaches a package-less row (the environment's item, or a `sys_metadata` row bound to no package) of a name two or more packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-closure`, naming every holder), where each holder's address served that row as its own, and the list scoped to a holder (which a send made from it reads) leaves the row out; for every type read by package (`PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`: `app`, `page`, `dashboard`, `report`, `book`, `analytics_cube`, `tool`, `skill`, `agent`, `api`, `email_template`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`, `permission`); first-party: 0, the full dogfood battery green with it. Widened beside it: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), its item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for an email template, a second package holder they refused before: one that declares a namespace other than the holder's.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/email-service.mdx` gains the `callerPackageId` member (how a send resolves its template name); no published skill teaches the scope of an email template name or the send's package; `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s customization paragraph (a pair's added locale served on the base's address, a dependent's only under its own `?package=`) stays true for every one-holder name and is pinned by the #28802 dogfood, which stays green.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (measured). For an email template, (4) changes the mail with no refusal: once a second package holds the name, the first holder's send moves from the operator's customized package-less wording to its own shipped wording, until the row is saved into one holder's pair. (1) No in-tree caller reads an email template with a package that does not hold it (Studio's bundle editor reads at the package its list names the item under). (2) No first-party package pair clashes on an email template name. (3) No first-party packaged flow's `notify` node names a `template:` or a literal `payload.template`: of the files under `examples/` and `packages/` (tests, dist and the engine itself excluded) that carry a `type: 'notify'` node, none carries a string `template:` key (the `notify` nodes of `app-showcase` and `app-todo` send inline `title` / `message`). (4) No first-party package pair holds one name of a package-read type beside a package-less row of it; the full dogfood battery (which boots the showcase, CRM and every example app) stays green with the refusal on. The full dogfood battery ran on the final head (Verification).

This is the first of three PRs for #31699 (seat ruling Q1 = A): email_template here, then webhook, then connector (`Fixes #31699`). Only `email_template` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here.

## Patch round 3

This round answers the delta contract review [6785448728](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6785448728) on `d8084865` (VERDICT PASS, two should-fix and three nits) under the claim amendment [6788098985](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31699#issuecomment-6788098985) and the epic answers [6788092691](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6788092691).

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **Merge** | Merged `origin/main` (the PR was `dirty`): `permission` (#32162) and `email_template` sit side by side in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` and objectql's `WIRED_SINCE`; #32162's permission describe and this PR's describes are both kept. Narrowing (4)'s type list now names `permission` too, since the package-less refusal covers every type in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`. | objectql `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`, `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` |
| **R2-A** (should-fix) — a row hydrated into the registry, stamped `''` or the provenance sentinel `sys_metadata`, skipped the package-less owner check | `exactQualifierItem` treats `''` and `sys_metadata` as no package before the owner check, so such a row of a name two packages hold is refused `409 ambiguous-in-closure` at both exact addresses. | objectql "[#31699] a package-less row…": a row registered into the registry stamped `sys_metadata`, and one stamped `''`, under two holders → 409 at both naming both; CONTROL one holder → served. Ablated A19 (2 red). |
| **R2-B** (should-fix) — what a holder's send does with a withheld package-less row | Epic answer 1: withholding is accepted. The changeset's BREAKING paragraph (and the narrowing paragraph here) now states the mail consequence: once a second package holds the name, the first holder's send moves from the operator's customized package-less wording to its own shipped wording, with no refusal, until the row is saved into one holder's pair. Epic answer 2 (a `409` for `?package=A` on a member A ships) is **superseded**: measured on the tree, that read serves A's own shipped member (`_packageId` A), never the package-less row, and A's list and a send from A serve the same; the landing seat and the epic seat agreed to keep it as measured (the correction is posted on this PR). | objectql "[#31699] a package-less row…": "a member the holder itself ships, beside a package-less row of a name two packages hold": for A and for B, the exact read and the list both serve the holder's own shipped member. |
| **N2r** | Changeset: the slotted-set sentence lists `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`, `permission`. Body: "What changes" gives the namespace set as `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`. | — |
| **N4** | Changeset: the `notify` bullet says a template named in the literal `payload.template` names the armed package too. | — |
| **N5** | Changeset: the send bullet no longer lists the environment overlay among what a two-holder name's address reads; a package-less overlay of such a name is left out. | — |

## Patch round 2

This round answers the contract review record [6772203835](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32214#issuecomment-6772203835) on `4c176c5b` (VERDICT FAIL), the epic seat's remaining red-line items (the package-less row; the App pair's registry slot), and the delta review of #32277 ([6774012987](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32277#issuecomment-6774012987): M1r, S2), whose owner-check order this branch shares, with the server seat's rulings on F-C and N1, in one push.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **Epic: the legacy package-less row under two holders** (replaces round 1's "declared, not changed") | `exactQualifierItem` asks `packageLessRowOwners` (exported from metadata-protocol) before keeping a row that carries no package: when two or more packages hold the name, the read is refused `409 ambiguous-in-closure` naming every holder. The package-scoped list leaves such a row out (`packageLessRowWithheld` in the stand-in rows), so a send made from either holder renders that holder's own. It is generic: every type in `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`; a platform-requested name (`auth.*`) and the `_env` address are untouched. `os migrate stored-references` lists each such `sys_metadata` row under `packageLessRows` with its candidates. Declared as narrowing (4) for every such type, `agent`, `skill` and the E8 types included. Census: first-party 0; the full battery green. | objectql `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` "[#31699] a package-less row of a name two packages hold": email_template two holders → 409 on both, each list and the send's read serve the holder's own; agent, skill, app, dashboard: env item + two holders → 409, + one holder → served; CONTROL `_env` unchanged. metadata-protocol `protocol-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: `packageLessRowOwners` names every holder, CONTROL `auth.*` and a type not read by package → none. CLI `stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`: THE PIN lists an agent and an email_template row with both candidates; CONTROL one holder, or a bound row → not listed. Ablated A10–A13. |
| **F-A** (must-fix) — a literal `payload.template` resolved environment-wide | The `notify` node records the armed package (`templateCallerPackageId`) when the literal `payload` carries a non-blank `template` string, as the channels read it, and the inline path forwards it; a literal `templateCallerPackageId` key is still dropped and replaced. | `notify-node.test.ts` "a template reference written in the literal payload … names the armed package too". Ablated A14. |
| **F-B** (= #32277 delta M1r) — a bound pair row was still served at the App's own address | The owner check is now one self-contained function, `pairRowOnAddress` (exported), which `exactQualifierItem` and `pairMemberWithheldAt` both ask, so a generic pair line (#32277) can hoist it to the top of the function. It reads the declared base (`overrides.package`) first, before the App-pair keep, in both the exact read and the list. | objectql "[#31699 F2]" "a bound row is served on its base only, even when the App itself holds the name beside it": served at X, refused and unlisted at the App. metadata-protocol "[#31699] pairRowOnAddress": declared base read first. Ablated A15 (exact read), A16 (list), A15b (unit) and A15c (one mutation in the shared function, dist). |
| **S2** (#32277 delta review) — a sole owner that is not among the address's bases was still served | `pairRowOnAddress` answers `not-member` when the row's one owner is not one of the address's bases, so the read falls through as for another package's item, and the list leaves it out. Through the doors today the qualifier refuses a non-holder first (`not-held-by-qualifier`), so the guard is pinned on the function. | metadata-protocol "[#31699] pairRowOnAddress": a sole owner elsewhere → `not-member`; CONTROL the owner's own address → `serve`. objectql "[#31699 F2]": a package sharing the pair but holding no template of the name does not serve the member (refused `409`) and does not list it. Ablated A17. |
| **App pair's registry slot** (epic ruling via seat 4) — `SchemaRegistry.getPackageScopedItem(type, name, APP)` returned the App pair's plain-slot row whatever it declared | `getPackageScopedItem` skips a paired `<base>.custom` row that declares another holder as its base (`pairRowDeclaresAnotherHolder`), so the App's address answers the App's own item. Generic for every type. | objectql `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts` "[#31699] a pair row that declares another holder as its base is skipped on the base's address": `email_template` and `page` answer the base's own item, the other holder's unchanged; CONTROL a pair row declaring its own base, or none, is still the base's. Ablated A18. |
| **F-C** — the remedy "declare `overrides.package`" has no door | Seat ruling: the read keeps honouring a declaration (fail-closed), and the report hints, the module doc and the changeset now say the truth: the save gate refuses the declaration on a member the base does not ship (`declared_package_ships_no_such_item`, #28777), so no door binds an added member to one base today and the row stays refused and listed until it is deleted. For a package-less row, where a holder ships the item, the remedy is saving the customization into that holder's pair declaring it and deleting the row. The bind door is raised with the epic seat as an open item. | CLI report text. |
| **F-D** — the changeset's legacy-row paragraph | Superseded by the epic fix: the paragraph now states the refusal. | — |
| **N1** | `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` (a template value refused at delivery; the level stays minor). | `check-adr-0087-registration` ✓ |
| **N2** | The changeset's slotted-set sentence lists `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `email_template`; narrowing (4) lists `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` in full. | — |
| **N3** | `email-service.mdx` documents `callerPackageId`; the Skills-docs line names the page. | `pnpm lint` ✓ |
| **③** | Merged `origin/main` at `fb71296c`: `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` keeps `mapping` and `dataset` beside `email_template`, and objectql's `WIRED_SINCE` carries `api`, `email_template`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset`. Then at `e31ea52a` (#32213, #32239, #32274), and at `326453eb` (#32310's caller arm: `CallerPackageAddress` exported beside this PR's owner helpers; `bareNameHoldersMeet` keeps the platform-requested `auth.*` exception ahead of spec's `namespacedHoldersMeet`; #32310's dataset describe and this PR's describes both kept): `action` and `email_template` both narrowed (`NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` = `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`; `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` = `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`); `flowCallerPackage` takes main's slot-key body (#31696) and stays public for the `notify` node. Full battery and CI on the final head. | Tests |
| **Second lander after #32277** (`9bff554e`); the doubles | One owner check: #32277's local pair line in `exactQualifierItem` now asks this PR's exported `pairRowOnAddress` (main's local `pairMemberOwners`, `declaredOverrideBase` and `isAppPairOf` copies dropped for the exported ones); the generic pair line covers every package-scoped type, as #32277 has it. The decision table is #32277's corrected order case by case: the App shortcut only when nothing or the App is declared; a sole owner served only when among the address's bases; no owner kept unless the row declares a base the address does not name. `email_template` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` where #32277 moved it (`@objectstack/core`). The package-less refusal stays on the types whose by-name readers consult `(package, name)` (`PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`): the other package-scoped types #32277 newly judges at `?package=` are out of scope (below). | metadata-protocol "the exact qualifier keeps a pair's item on its base's address": the pair's item is the base's own for every type (the CONTROLs that pinned the old bundled-only gate now pin #32277's generic line). objectql #32277's "[#32076]" pair-row describe stays green; its premise now reads `readsByPackage('email_template') === true`. Four getItem-reading doubles that bare-read an email template (metadata-protocol `protocol.reads-environment-only`, rest `rest-server-meta-read-org-scope` and `rest-server-meta-history-diff-org-scope`, runtime `meta-write-org-scope`) now say they read it by package, as `SchemaRegistry` does; without that #32277's `narrowed` arm refuses them `501`. |

## Patch round 1

This round answers the contract review record [6761777785](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32089#issuecomment-6761777785) (VERDICT FAIL) under the epic seat's rulings [6761802819](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32089#issuecomment-6761802819), from `claude/project-thread-x11fa6@a52f89e0` merged with `origin/main`.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **F1** (must-fix, epic: root fix) — the send resolved caller-less, so every send of a two-holder name would have been refused | `SendTemplateInput` / `RenderTemplateInput.callerPackageId` (spec); `EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate` hands it to every `TemplateLoader.load` rung and `bundleLocales`; the registry loader resolves D3 from it (`bundleAddressOf`) and, for a name two packages hold, reads only the resolved holder's address (`getMetaItemsForExecution({ type, packageId })`). The `notify` node records `AutomationEngine.flowCallerPackage(context)` (the flow's armed package, never the definition's `_packageId` stamp) as `templateCallerPackageId`; the email and inbox channels forward it. A literal payload key of that name is dropped. | plugin-email `template-loader.test.ts` "[#31699 F1]": own holder per namespace (alpha, beta), closure holder, outside-closure 409, **no package: two holders → 409** (undefined and null), one holder → served, environment item → served, dependent addition reads its base, registry-only narrowing. `send-template.test.ts`: the caller reaches every rung (control: omitted / null / empty → none). `notify-node.test.ts`: armed package named, env body stamped `_packageId` names none, literal key dropped, inline path names none. `email-channel.test.ts`, `inbox-channel.test.ts`: forwarded (control: absent). The package-scoped list (#28802 block) leaves such a row out (`pairMemberWithheldAt`). `os migrate stored-references` lists it under `pairMembers` with its candidates. | objectql `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` "[#31699 F2]": two holders → 409 on both exact reads naming both, both lists omit it; one holder → served (#28390 A); the App's own address → served; after a bind (`overrides.package: X`) → served at X only. Round 1 declared the legacy package-less row under two holders as unchanged; round 2 refuses it (above).

## What changes

- **The switch.** `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`@objectstack/core`) gains `'email_template'` (now `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `email_template`); `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` gains it after `'api'`.
- **Platform-requested names.** Core's `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` gains the eight `auth.*` mails; they resolve environment-wide whatever the caller and keep one overriding package per deployment.
- **Bundle addition.** A package that ships only locales its base does not ship is still judged against the base whatever the namespaces (`isBundleAdditionPair`); a send made from it resolves from its closure.
- **The send (F1).** `callerPackageId` on the send contract, through `EmailService`, `TemplateLoader` (`TemplateLoadOptions`, exported) and the registry loader, which narrows to the resolved holder's address only when two or more packages hold the name, so every one-holder name reads byte-identically to before. The `notify` node, `templateCallerPackageOf` in service-messaging, and both channels.
- **Exact qualifier (F2, round 2; merged with #32277).** `pairMemberOwners`, and the one owner check `pairRowOnAddress` (declared base first, the App's own pair, two owners refused, a sole owner elsewhere not served) that the exact read and `pairMemberWithheldAt` both ask, in metadata-protocol; `packageLessRowOwners` / `packageLessRowWithheld` refuse and withhold a package-less row of a name two packages hold, for every type read by package; both owner helpers exported for the CLI.
- **Registry.** `SchemaRegistry.getPackageScopedItem` skips a pair row that declares another holder as its base.
- **Notify (F-A).** A literal `payload.template` names the armed package as `template:` does.
- **Docs.** `email-service.mdx`: `callerPackageId`.
- **Upgrade report.** `collectStoredPackageReferences` adds `pairMembers` (a keyset walk of active `sys_metadata` rows of package-read types stored under a customization package with two or more owners); `os migrate stored-references` and `packageLessRows` (package-less active rows of package-read types whose name two or more packages hold); `os migrate stored-references` prints both, with hints that say no door binds an added member to one base today, and counts them in its total.
- **Unchanged.** The refusal's envelope, code and sentence; every type outside the set; the webhook and connector readers (PRs 2 and 3).

## Tests
